mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS "totalCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE CNTC_STAT_CD NOT IN ('HOLD','CTRT'))::int AS "activeCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE CNTC_STAT_CD='ITVW')::int AS "interviewScheduledCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE CNTC_STAT_CD NOT IN ('HOLD','CTRT') AND INPUT_PSBL_DT <= #{nextMonth})::int AS "availableByNextMonthCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE CNTC_STAT_CD NOT IN ('HOLD','CTRT') AND LAST_CNTC_DT < #{overdueBefore})::int AS "overdueContactCount" FROM TB_HR_CAND
SELECT JOB_CD AS "jobCode", INPUT_PSBL_DT AS "availableDate" FROM TB_HR_CAND WHERE CNTC_STAT_CD NOT IN ('HOLD','CTRT') ORDER BY CAND_ID

SELECT c.CODE_GRP_ID AS "groupId", c.CODE AS "code", c.CODE_NM AS "name", c.ADD_VAL1 AS "target" FROM TB_SY_CODE c JOIN TB_SY_CODE_GRP g ON g.CODE_GRP_ID=c.CODE_GRP_ID WHERE c.CODE_GRP_ID=#{groupId} AND c.USE_YN='Y' AND c.DEL_YN='N' AND g.USE_YN='Y' ORDER BY c.SORT_ORD,c.CODE
SELECT CLNT_ID AS "id",CLNT_NM AS "name" FROM TB_BS_CLNT WHERE USE_YN='Y' AND CLNT_TYPE_CD IN ('VNDR','BOTH') ORDER BY CLNT_ID
SELECT AREA_CD AS "code",SIDO_NM AS "sido",SIDO_FULL_NM AS "sidoFull",SGG_NM AS "district" FROM TB_SY_ADM_AREA WHERE USE_YN='Y' AND SGG_NM IS NOT NULL AND EMD_NM IS NULL ORDER BY AREA_CD
